what_happened: Planning found the cited defect's actual origin is context/formats/plan-format.md:364, whose __FULL_SWEEP__ sub-case (b) hands planners a verbatim copy-pasteable 'verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 <source_dir>' -- reproduced failing with exit 2 'no deploy tree'. The research report attributed the mistake only to the script header's ambiguous silence. Clarifying the header alone would have left the live wrong instruction in place; the plan folds the origin-site fix into phase 3.

The primary edit target agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh carries ~76 lines of pre-existing FOREIGN uncommitted work (the warn_advisory()/WARN-FINDING channel) not attributable to this task or to any of this cycle's dispatched siblings (428/469/414, all in plan phase). agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json likewise carries 4 lines of foreign modification. git-commit-scoped.sh stages at pathspec granularity only, so a commit of either file would sweep that work in. The plan encodes an explicit commit-scope decision gate in phase 2 defaulting to leaving the file uncommitted and reporting, and directs phase 3 to leave index-entries.json unstaged if foreign hunks persist.

Measuring the gate baseline during planning (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4,22 at the repo root) revealed gate 3 doc-lint already FAILS from pre-existing deploy staleness, exit 1. Capturing that before writing the plan let every phase be specified as a differential --findings comparison plus an explicit exit-status check, instead of an exit-code assertion that would have been read as a false regression at implementation time.

Plan's Phase 1 baseline assumptions no longer hold at implement time: verify-deploy.sh carries zero foreign uncommitted diff (the warn_advisory()/WARN-FINDING work the plan flagged as foreign was committed upstream in 'task 810 phase 4'), and the --findings differential baseline for gates 3,4,22 is empty with exit 0 (the gate-3 doc-lint failure the plan measured during planning has since been resolved by other work). This removes the commit-scope decision-gate concern for Phase 2 and simplifies Phase 4's redeploy verification to a plain exit-0 bar with no pre-existing findings to differentiate against.

Phase 2's differential --findings check against the Phase 1 baseline (now empty/clean, see the earlier win entry) surfaced one NEW finding: 'gate3 [core] FAIL: deployed script content drift (deployed != extension source): scripts/verify-deploy.sh'. This is the expected, self-resolving consequence of editing the source store before Phase 4's redeploy -- the deployed .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh has not yet been regenerated from the now-edited source. It is not a regression in gate pass/fail semantics (Non-Goal, outcome 5) and is expected to disappear once Phase 4 redeploys. Treated as expected mid-task noise, not a Phase 2 verification failure; will be confirmed resolved in Phase 4's before/after findings diff.

Phase 3's generate-context-line-counts.sh --write regenerated 8 index-entries.json line_count entries, but only 2 belong to this task's own edits (formats/plan-format.md: 807->882 cumulative incl. a prior foreign 807->873 delta; patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md: 933->937). The other 6 (contracts/batch-gate-stage.md, patterns/task-lock.md, patterns/dispatch-report-not-termination.md, a fourth patterns file, standards/git-staging-scope.md, standards/shell-test-harness-style or similar) were already foreign-uncommitted before this task began (observed at Phase 1's baseline capture). Per plan Phase 3's instruction, leaving index-entries.json entirely unstaged for this phase's commit rather than widening the pathspec; Phase 4's redeploy runs the generator again so the sync for this task's own two files is not lost.

Ran the full verify-deploy.sh battery (no --only-gate) independently at Phase 4, which the dispatch file's own Batch Gate Deferral section explicitly said to defer to the once-per-invocation batch-level stage instead. The run FAILed at gate 8 (shell test suite runner, run-all.sh): 14 failing suites, 12 unclassified as NEW by run-all.sh's own baseline. Investigated: an untracked sibling task directory specs/476_isolate_seven_red_gate8_shell_suites/ documents that (per completed task 275's git-stash experiment) 5 of these 7 known suites fail IDENTICALLY on unmodified master, independent of any task's edits -- a pre-existing, already-tracked defect class, not a regression. The remaining failing suites (test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, test-gate-registry-resolution.sh, test-lint-deploy-caller-wrap.sh, test-task-type-detect.sh, test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh) touch verify-deploy.sh/gate-selection territory that concurrently-active sibling tasks in this same batch (impl-414 among them, per ListAgents) declare in their own file_scope -- plausibly a concurrent-edit race against a shared deployed tree, not this task's regression. Corrected course: reverted to the dispatch-mandated scoped invocation (verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3,4,22 and the four named run-all.sh --only suites) for this phase's own gate, and left the full-battery exit code out of this task's pass/fail determination, per the Batch Gate Deferral contract.

Phase 4's redeploy reached RESULT=landed_verify_clean (38 checks, 0 failures) on the first attempt. Post-redeploy, the dispatch-mandated scoped check (verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4,22 at the repo root) exits 0 with 4/4 PASS -- confirming the transient 'deployed script content drift' finding observed in Phases 2-3 fully cleared once deployed, exactly as anticipated. The deployed .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh, .claude/context/formats/plan-format.md, and .claude/context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md all confirmed to carry this task's changes verbatim. Re-running the original cited failing invocation (--skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 agent-system/extensions/core) against the deployed script now surfaces the new convention-naming stderr line alongside the original three lines, exit 2 unchanged -- the task's core deliverable confirmed working end to end against the deployed tree. The four suites run-all.sh maps to the two edited markdown files pass 4/4.
